COMPANY

Lunatrix is an open product layer around model intelligence.

Build the signal stack so it can actually be used.

Lunatrix exists to make forecast intelligence easier to publish, inspect, and integrate. The project treats the model as one part of the product, not the whole story. Delivery, transparency, and clean integration surfaces matter too.

See the architecture Read the docs

Open by default

The product direction favors visible interfaces, inspectable routes, and a stack other developers can work with.

Separate concerns

Frontend presentation, gateway logic, and model execution are kept independent so each layer stays maintainable.

Ship useful signals

The goal is not just to train a model, but to make the intelligence consumable in real trading workflows.

“Lunatrix is built like infrastructure first: visible interfaces, stable routes, and a model service that can stand on its own.”

Mission

Turn model intelligence into a cleaner product surface for bots, users, and internal operators.

Approach

Keep the stack local-first, open-source ready, and explicit about where each responsibility sits.

Outcome

A signal product that feels coherent from inference to API to public presentation instead of pieced together.
